_comment: Probe configuration (SPEC-001 CA-1/CA-2). Model ids, runs, prices and weights are configuration, not code (FOUNDATION No-negociables). Values follow the most recent dated sdd-probe dictamen (vigente): docs/epicas/EPIC-001-ciclo-0-baseline-y-validacion-del-problema/SPEC-002-ejecucion-del-probe-baseline-y-veredicto-de-la-hipotesis.ledger.md (2026-09-29; supersedes the SPEC-001 one of 2026-09-23). Re-check each app's default model before every probe run.

batch._comment: Default batch: Vigo/Pontevedra baseline of EPIC-001 (SPEC-002). ADR-003 §3-§4 / SPEC-008 CA-3-CA-4: prompts, local cities and member brands are configuration. A brand takes part in a batch only if listed here (membership, not city): pilot brands based in Vigo never enter this batch (ADR-005 §5).
batch.name: vigo-pontevedra
batch.title: Resumen del probe Vigo/Pontevedra

claude._effort_comment: medium as in the Claude apps (Sonnet 5.5 default there), decided by the human 2026-09-29 (F-SPEC-002-4, D-5): https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-releases-claude-sonnet-5-5-at-unchanged-sonnet-5-pricing/ (2026-09-28). max_tokens bounds thinking + answer per request (thinking counts toward it: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/effort); 16000 leaves room for adaptive thinking at medium and stays under the anthropic SDK non-streaming limit (21333).
claude.model_source: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/28/claude-sonnet-5-5/ (2026-09-28: Sonnet 5.5 is now the model used for the free tier on claude.ai); https://www.anthropic.com/claude/sonnet (anyone can chat with Sonnet 5.5 on Claude.ai, web, iOS and Android)

openai.model_source: https://www.macrumors.com/2026/08/06/chatgpt-free-unlimited-text-chats/ (GPT-5.6 Luna = default for Free and Go since 2026-08-06); GPT-6 Luna announced 2026-09-22, still not in Chat on 2026-09-29 (Free/Go: desktop app only; ChatGPT: Work and Codex): https://9to5mac.com/2026/09/22/openai-upgrading-chatgpt-and-codex-with-two-more-gpt-6-models/ ; https://releasebot.io/updates/openai/chatgpt

price.source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (price valid through 2026-12-31; 5,000 free searches/month ignored, conservative)
